words.gloss: whose father and mother are present

hindi: जो पिता वाले हैं, जिनके पिता-माता विद्यमान हैं, वे पुत्र स्वामी नहीं हैं।
english: Sons who have a father, whose father and mother are present, are not lords.
notes: sthita = standing, remaining; 'present' (likely 'living') is the contextual sense. Over what the sons are not lords is not stated; the next units concern property. 'are' is the bare copula.

hindi: उनके बाद पिता से दाय का विभाग है, पिता के द्रव्यों का।
english: After them [there is] the division of the inheritance from the father, of the father's property.
notes: 'them' (teṣām) presumably the parents of unit 1; 'are/is' is the bare copula. pitṛtaḥ 'from the father' (alternatively 'according to the father').

hindi: स्वयं अर्जित किया हुआ बाँटने योग्य नहीं है, पिता के द्रव्य से उठे हुओं को छोड़कर।
english: What is self-acquired is not to be divided, except [in the case of] those risen from paternal property.
notes: utthitebhyaḥ is plural dative/ablative of unstated gender (persons or gains); literal 'risen from paternal property'. Alternative: gains made by using the father's property. Doubtful.

hindi: पिता के द्रव्य से अविभक्त रूप में आए हुओं के पुत्र अथवा पौत्र “चौथे तक” अंश के भागी हैं।
english: Sons or grandsons of those who have come undivided from paternal property are sharers — “up to the fourth”.
notes: upagata (from upa-√gam) is vague: 'come to / reached / obtained'; the object is not stated. The phrase 'ā caturthāt' is quoted by iti; 'fourth' (generation) is not stated in the Sanskrit.
lines_deva: पितृ.द्रव्याद् अविभक्त.उपगतानां पुत्राः पौत्रा वा आ.चतुर्थाद् इत्य् अंश.भाजः
lines_iast: pitṛ.dravyād avibhakta.upagatānāṃ putrāḥ pautrā vā ā.caturthād ity aṃśa.bhājaḥ

hindi: उतने तक पिण्ड अविच्छिन्न है।
english: To that extent the piṇḍa is unbroken.
notes: piṇḍa kept untranslated (literally 'lump, ball'; in this context probably the funeral offering shared by the line of descent; not stated in the line). tāvat picks up 'ā caturthāt' of unit 4.

hindi: जिनका पिण्ड विच्छिन्न है, वे सब समान रूप से बाँटें।
english: Those whose piṇḍa is broken, all, should divide equally.
notes: Hindi 'वे' is the correlative of 'जिनका'.

hindi: जो पिता के द्रव्य से रहित हैं अथवा जिनके पिता के द्रव्य का विभाजन हो चुका है, साथ जीते हुए वे फिर से बाँटें।
english: Those who have no paternal property, or whose paternal property has been divided, living together, should divide again.
notes: 'saha jīvantaḥ' is literally 'living together'; whether it means joint living or only being alive together is not decided here.
lines_deva: अपितृ.द्रव्या विभक्त.पितृ.द्रव्या वा सह जीवन्तः पुनर् विभजेरन्
lines_iast: apitṛ.dravyā vibhakta.pitṛ.dravyā vā saha jīvantaḥ punar vibhajeran

hindi: और जिससे उत्थान हो, वह दुगुना अंश पाए।
english: And from whom a rise should come about, he should obtain a double share.
notes: Obscure: yatas can be 'from whom / whence / because'; uttiṣṭh 'rise, arise, get up'. A literal rendering is kept; a likely sense is that the one who raises (increases) the family property gets a double share, but the line does not say so. 'dvy' is regular sandhi of dvi + aṃśa.

hindi: पुत्र-रहित का द्रव्य सहोदर भाई अथवा साथ जीने वाले भाई और कन्याएँ ले लें।
english: The property of one without a son should be taken by uterine brothers, or by brothers living together, and by daughters.
notes: kanyā is 'girl, unmarried daughter'; rendered 'daughters' in the sentence, literal 'girls'. Whether the three groups share or rank is not stated.
lines_deva: द्रव्यम् अपुत्रस्य सोदर्या भ्रातरः सह.जीविनो वा हरेयुः कन्याश् च
lines_iast: dravyam aputrasya sodaryā bhrātaraḥ saha.jīvino vā hareyuḥ kanyāś ca

hindi: पुत्रवान् का रिक्थ धर्मिष्ठ विवाहों में उत्पन्न पुत्र अथवा पुत्रियाँ ले लें।
english: The inheritance of one having sons [should be taken by] sons or daughters born in the most righteous marriages.
notes: The verb is not in the line; 'should take' (hareyuḥ of unit 9) is carried over, bracketed in English; Hindi supplies it without bracket. dharmiṣṭha is a superlative, 'most righteous'.
lines_deva: रिक्थं पुत्रवतः पुत्रा दुहितरो वा धर्मिष्ठेषु विवाहेषु जाताः
lines_iast: rikthaṃ putravataḥ putrā duhitaro vā dharmiṣṭheṣu vivāheṣu jātāḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. ātm. √dhṛ

hindi: उनके अभाव में जीवित पिता।
english: In their absence, the father, being alive.
notes: Fragment: the verb is not given and is not supplied (the sense continues from unit 9, 'should take'). dharamāṇa is an irregular present participle of √dhṛ (cf. dhriyamāṇa), 'continuing, being alive'.

words.gloss: in the absence of the father

hindi: पिता के अभाव में भाई और भाइयों के पुत्र।
english: In the absence of the father, brothers and brothers' sons.
notes: Fragment; the verb is not given. 'pitr.abhāve' is regular sandhi of pitṛ + abhāve, no typo.

hindi: पितृहीन भाई और भाइयों के पुत्र, बहुत होने पर भी, पिता का एक अंश ले लें।
english: Fatherless brothers and brothers' sons, even though many, should take one share of the father.
notes: 'apitṛkāḥ' may qualify both groups or only the brothers; here taken with both. 'one share of the father' means one share in the father's portion.
lines_deva: अपितृका बहवो ऽपि च भ्रातरो भ्रातृ.पुत्राश् च पितुर् एकम् अंशं हरेयुः
lines_iast: apitṛkā bahavo 'pi ca bhrātaro bhrātṛ.putrāś ca pitur ekam aṃśaṃ hareyuḥ

words.gloss: of those of the same womb

hindi: अनेक पिताओं वाले सहोदरों के दाय का विभाग पिता से है।
english: Of those of the same womb who have several fathers, the division of inheritance is from the father.
notes: 'is' is the bare copula. pitṛtaḥ 'from the father' as in unit 2; the sense 'father by father' (each group by its own father) is likely but is not stated.

words.gram: m. loc. sg., pres. part. pass. √vid

hindi: पिता, भाइयों और पुत्रों में पूर्व के विद्यमान होने पर वे बाद वाले का आश्रय नहीं लेते, और ज्येष्ठ के रहते धन ग्रहण करने वाले कनिष्ठ का आश्रय नहीं लेते।
english: Among fathers, brothers and sons, when the earlier is present they do not depend on the later; and, the eldest [being present, they do not depend on] the youngest who takes the wealth.
notes: Doubtful. The second clause has no verb; 'do not depend on' is carried over, bracketed in English. The subject of avalambante is not stated. pitṛ-bhrātṛ-putrāṇām is read as a dvandva; alternative: 'of the sons of the father's brothers'. 'jyeṣṭhe' is read as a locative absolute with an omitted 'present'.
lines_deva: पितृ.भ्रातृ.पुत्राणां पूर्वे विद्यमाने न-अपरम् अवलम्बन्ते, ज्येष्ठे च कनिष्ठम् अर्थ.ग्राहिणम्
lines_iast: pitṛ.bhrātṛ.putrāṇāṃ pūrve vidyamāne na-aparam avalambante, jyeṣṭhe ca kaniṣṭham artha.grāhiṇam

hindi: जीवित रहते विभाग में पिता एक को विशिष्ट न करे।
english: In a division while he is living, the father should not single out one.
notes: viśeṣayet literally 'make distinguished'; the likely sense is 'favour one with a larger share', not stated in the line. 'he' (the father) in English is supplied by the sense of jīvat.

hindi: और बिना कारण एक को अलग विभक्त न करे।
english: And he should not divide out one without cause.
notes: nirvibhajeta (nir-vi-√bhaj) literally 'divide out, separate off'; the likely sense is 'exclude one from the partition'. Subject is the father of unit 16.

words.gram: m./n. loc. sg., pres. part. a-√as

hindi: पिता के धन के न रहने पर बड़े छोटों पर अनुग्रह करें, मिथ्या आचरण वालों को छोड़कर।
english: When the father's property does not exist, the elder ones should favour the younger, except [in the case of] those of false conduct.
notes: 'pituḥ asati arthe' is read 'when the father's property does not exist' (alternative: when the father is not there to give). anugṛhṇīyuḥ 'favour' (support, oblige); the form of favour is not stated.
lines_deva: पितुर् असत्य् अर्थे ज्येष्ठाः कनिष्ठान् अनुगृह्णीयुः, अन्यत्र मिथ्या.वृत्तेभ्यः
lines_iast: pitur asaty arthe jyeṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhān anugṛhṇīyuḥ, anyatra mithyā.vṛttebhyaḥ

hindi: व्यवहार प्राप्त कर चुकने वालों का विभाग है।
english: The division is of those who have reached dealings.
notes: vyavahāra kept literal 'dealings'; here probably legal capacity (majority), not stated in the line. 'is' is the bare copula.

words.gloss: cleared of what is to be given

hindi: जो व्यवहार को प्राप्त नहीं हुए हैं, उनका देय से शुद्ध किया हुआ धन मातृ-बन्धुओं अथवा ग्राम के वृद्धों के पास रखें, व्यवहार की प्राप्ति तक, अथवा प्रवास में गए हुए का।
english: Of those who have not reached dealings, [they] should place [the property], cleared of what is to be given, with the mother's kin or village elders until the reaching of dealings — or [that] of one who has gone away.
notes: The object (deya-viśuddham, neuter accusative) is not named; 'property' is supplied in brackets in English only. deya-viśuddha probably 'cleared of debts'. The subject of sthāpayeyuḥ is not stated. 'proṣitasya vā' read as a second case ('or of one who has gone away'), with 'until his return' not stated.
lines_deva: अप्राप्त.व्यवहाराणां देय.विशुद्धं मातृ.बन्धुषु ग्राम.वृद्धेषु वा स्थापयेयुः आ.व्यवहार.प्रापणात्, प्रोषितस्य वा
lines_iast: aprāpta.vyavahārāṇāṃ deya.viśuddhaṃ mātṛ.bandhuṣu grāma.vṛddheṣu vā sthāpayeyuḥ ā.vyavahāra.prāpaṇāt, proṣitasya vā

hindi: बसे हुओं के समान बिना बसे हुओं को नैवेशनिक दें, और कन्याओं को प्रादानिक दें।
english: They should give the naiveśanika to the unsettled, equal to the settled, and the prādānika to girls.
notes: naiveśanika and prādānika kept untranslated (obscure: from niveśana 'settling in' and pradāna 'giving away'); alternatives: marriage/settling-in expenses and gift-portion. saṃniviṣṭa is read 'settled' (probably married); spelled with m before n in the edition throughout, not flagged. The subject of dadyuḥ is not stated.
lines_deva: सम्निविष्ट.समम् असम्निविष्टेभ्यो नैवेशनिकं दद्युः, कन्याभ्यश् च प्रादानिकम्
lines_iast: samniviṣṭa.samam asamniviṣṭebhyo naiveśanikaṃ dadyuḥ, kanyābhyaś ca prādānikam

hindi: ऋण-रिक्थ का विभाग समान है।
english: Of debt and inheritance the division is equal.
notes: The dual may be genitive ('of') or locative ('in'). 'is' is the bare copula.

hindi: “जल-पात्र भी निष्किञ्चन बाँट लें,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “Those who have nothing should divide even the water-vessels,” say the teachers.
notes: uda = 'water' (udaka). The quoted view is that of the unnamed teachers; Kautilya's reply follows in unit 24.

hindi: “यह छल है,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “This is a deceit,” says Kautilya.
notes: chala 'deceit, trick, pretext'; 'is' is the bare copula. Kautilya's reply to the teachers' view in unit 23.

words.gram: m./n. gen. sg., pres. part. a-√as

hindi: विद्यमान धन का विभाग होता है, अविद्यमान का नहीं।
english: The division is of existing property, not of the non-existent.
notes: artha = wealth/property. 'is' is the bare copula.

words.gram: m. nom. sg., compound (prati + aṃśa, 'each share')

hindi: “इतना धन साझा है, उसका प्रत्येक अंश इतना है,” यह दोहराकर, साक्षियों के बीच कहते हुए, विभाग कराए।
english: Having repeated “So much is the common property; of it, so much is each share,” and saying [it] among the witnesses, he should have the division made.
notes: The subject of kārayet and the one who speaks are not stated. anubhāṣya (anu-√bhāṣ) 'repeat, state after'. 'saying [it]' supplies the object.
lines_deva: एतावान् अर्थः सामान्यस् तस्य-एतावान् प्रत्य्.अंश इत्य् अनुभाष्य ब्रुवन् साक्षिषु विभागं कारयेत्
lines_iast: etāvān arthaḥ sāmānyas tasya-etāvān praty.aṃśa ity anubhāṣya bruvan sākṣiṣu vibhāgaṃ kārayet

hindi: जो गलत ढंग से बँटा हो, एक-दूसरे से हरण किया गया हो, छिपाया गया हो, अथवा अज्ञात रूप से उत्पन्न हुआ हो, उसे फिर से बाँटें।
english: What has been badly divided, taken from one another, concealed, or arisen without being known, they should divide again.
notes: The thing divided is not named (neuter participles). anyonya-apahṛta: 'taken by one another' or 'from one another'. avijñāta-utpanna literally 'arisen unknown' (a gain no one knew of).
lines_deva: दुर्विभक्तम् अन्योन्य.अपहृतम् अन्तर्हितम् अविज्ञात.उत्पन्नं वा पुनर् विभजेरन्
lines_iast: durvibhaktam anyonya.apahṛtam antarhitam avijñāta.utpannaṃ vā punar vibhajeran

words.gloss: excluding women's livelihood and the work for the deceased
from the property of a śrotriya

hindi: दायाद-रहित को राजा ले ले, स्त्रियों की जीविका, मृतक के कार्य को छोड़कर, श्रोत्रिय के द्रव्य को छोड़कर।
english: The king should take the heirless [property], excluding the livelihood of women and the work for the deceased, except [in the case of] the property of a śrotriya (Veda-learned man).
notes: The compound strī-vṛtti-preta-kārya-varjam may also be read as one chain; kārya 'what is to be done', probably funeral rites, not stated. adāyādaka: the noun it qualifies is not stated; 'property' bracketed.
lines_deva: अदायादकं राजा हरेत् स्त्री.वृत्ति.प्रेत.कार्य.वर्जम्, अन्यत्र श्रोत्रिय.द्रव्यात्
lines_iast: adāyādakaṃ rājā haret strī.vṛtti.preta.kārya.varjam, anyatra śrotriya.dravyāt

words.gloss: to those of the three Vedas

hindi: उसे त्रैवेद्यों को दे।
english: He should give that to those of the three Vedas (traivedya).
notes: traivedya 'of the three Vedas', i.e. men learned in them. Subject (the king of unit 28) is carried over.

hindi: पतित, पतित से उत्पन्न और क्लीब अंश-रहित हैं; और जड़, उन्मत्त, अन्धे और कुष्ठी अंश-रहित हैं।
english: The fallen one, one born of a fallen one, and the impotent are without shares; and the dull, mad, blind and leprous [are without shares].
notes: The second list has no predicate; 'are without shares' is carried over. jaḍa 'dull, inert'; klība 'impotent' (literally neuter); kuṣṭhin 'afflicted with kuṣṭha', rendered 'leprous'.
lines_deva: पतितः पतिताज् जातः क्लीबश् च-अनंशाः, जड.उन्मत्त.अन्ध.कुष्ठिनश् च
lines_iast: patitaḥ patitāj jātaḥ klībaś ca-anaṃśāḥ, jaḍa.unmatta.andha.kuṣṭhinaś ca

words.gloss: in the matter of a wife

hindi: पत्नी के प्रयोजन के होने पर उनकी, उनके जैसी न होने वाली, सन्तान भाग ले।
english: When there is the matter of a wife, their offspring, not of that kind, should take a share.

text_flags.why: possible: the long ā of bhāryā expected before arthe; or bhārya 'one to be maintained'

notes: Doubtful. 'bhārya.arthe' read as bhāryā-arthe, 'in the matter of a wife' (artha = matter, purpose); alternative bhārya 'to be maintained'. 'teṣām' refers to the persons excluded in unit 30; 'not of that kind' means not like them. The sense of the whole line is uncertain.
lines_deva: सति भार्य.अर्थे तेषाम् अपत्यम् अतद्.विधं भागं हरेत्
lines_iast: sati bhārya.arthe teṣām apatyam atad.vidhaṃ bhāgaṃ haret

hindi: ग्रास-आच्छादन — शेष, पतितों को छोड़कर।
english: Food and clothing — the others, the fallen being excluded.
notes: Fragment: no verb. grāsa 'morsel', ācchādana 'covering'. It probably continues from unit 30 (those without shares receive food and clothing), not stated.

hindi: और जिन्होंने पत्नियाँ ग्रहण की हैं, उनके प्रजनन के लुप्त होने पर बन्धु पुत्रों को उत्पन्न करें; वह उनके अंशों का निर्धारण करे।
english: And of those who have taken wives, procreation being lost, the relatives should bring forth sons; he should fix their shares.
notes: prakalpayet is singular after the plural sṛjeyuḥ; the subject 'he' (perhaps the king or the person dividing) is not stated; metre (anuṣṭubh, 16 syllables each line) agrees with the printed text. sṛj 'emit, bring forth': the means is not stated. Continues the persons of units 30-32.
lines_deva: तेषां च कृत.दाराणां लुप्ते प्रजनने सति
सृजेयुर् बान्धवाः पुत्रांस् तेषाम् अंशान् प्रकल्पयेत्
lines_iast: teṣāṃ ca kṛta.dārāṇāṃ lupte prajanane sati
sṛjeyur bāndhavāḥ putrāṃs teṣām aṃśān prakalpayet
